answer: DeepWalk is the method presented as exploiting missing information well. It uses truncated random walks and skip-gram to capture indirect, multi-hop co-occurrence relations, which can reveal connections that are not directly observed. LINE is the method that explicitly models both observed ties (first-order proximity, the direct edges between nodes) and shared-neighborhood similarity (second-order proximity, where nodes with similar neighbor distributions get similar embeddings).
